name: Lori Loud
source:
Lori's my eldest sister and the queen of No! Okay, maybe that's a little mean of me to say, Lori loves all of us, it's just… well I imagine being the eldest of 11 and having to keep us all in line drives her crazy sometimes!

She's about as emotional as [url=https://vndb.org/c151406]Dad[/url] is and that's literally saying something! [i]'Literally'[/i] also happens to be her favorite word too! Overall I'd say Lori loves four things… Her boyfriend [url=https://vndb.org/c151359]Bobby[/url], her phone, gold, and her family. But I'd be afraid of asking her to rank those in any order!

Lori's also good for getting a ride when [url=https://vndb.org/c151352]Mom[/url] and Dad can't drive us around. She asks for favors in return, but who else is willing to drop everything to take [url=https://vndb.org/c151341]me[/url] to the comic book store? If I have to paint her nails or do her laundry, it's a good trade. When she's not talking on her phone, she's usually hanging out with [url=https://vndb.org/c151354]Leni[/url], who I'd say is her best friend.

[In game description]
